title: OpenIRN — Supervision opérationnelle
description: Synthèse, usage, performance, sécurité, infrastructure et exploitation de l'instance OpenIRN supervisée.

config.content:
# OpenIRN — Supervision opérationnelle

Vue sur 24 h, actualisée chaque minute. Les identifiants d'usage et de sécurité sont exclusivement des pseudonymes HMAC.

## Synthèse

Disponibilité, état courant, requêtes/min, taux de 5xx, latence p95 et âge de la dernière sauvegarde.

data_source.query:
FROM synthetics-http-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND service.name == "openirn-api"
| EVAL is_up = CASE(monitor.status == "up", 1.0, 0.0)
| STATS availability_raw = AVG(is_up) * 100
| EVAL availability_pct = ROUND(availability_raw, 3)
| KEEP availability_pct

FROM synthetics-http-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND service.name == "openirn-api"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 1
| EVAL current_state = CASE(monitor.status == "up", 1, 0)
| KEEP current_state

FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 5 minutes AND url.path != "/health"
| STATS request_count = COUNT(*)
| EVAL requests_per_minute = ROUND(request_count / 5.0, 1)
| KEEP requests_per_minute

FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| EVAL is_5xx = CASE(http.response.status_code >= 500, 1.0, 0.0)
| STATS error_rate = ROUND(AVG(is_5xx) * 100, 3)
| KEEP error_rate

FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS p95_ns = PERCENTILE(event.duration, 95)
| EVAL p95_ms = ROUND(p95_ns / 1000000, 1)
| KEEP p95_ms

FROM logs-openirn.operations-*
| WHERE event.action == "backup.created" AND event.outcome == "success"
| STATS last_backup = MAX(@timestamp)
| EVAL backup_age_hours = ROUND(DATE_DIFF("minute", last_backup, NOW()) / 60.0, 1)
| KEEP backup_age_hours

FROM synthetics-http-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND service.name == "openirn-api"
| EVAL is_up = CASE(monitor.status == "up", 1.0, 0.0)
| STATS availability_pct = AVG(is_up) * 100 BY time = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time

config.content:
## Usage

Trafic par route, codes HTTP, clients et tenants pseudonymisés, plateformes et trafic Apache.

data_source.query:
FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY time = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), status = http.response.status_code
| SORT time

FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND url.path != "/health"
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY route = url.path
| SORT requests DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND device.id != ""
| STATS active_clients = COUNT_DISTINCT(device.id)

FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND organization.id != ""
| STATS active_tenants = COUNT_DISTINCT(organization.id)

FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND openirn.client.platform != ""
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY platform = openirn.client.platform
| SORT requests DESC

FROM logs-apache.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__" AND url.path LIKE "/api/*"
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY time = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time

config.content:
## Performance

Latences p50/p95/p99, routes lentes, erreurs proxy et saturation des workers Apache.

data_source.query:
FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS p50_ns = PERCENTILE(event.duration, 50), p95_ns = PERCENTILE(event.duration, 95), p99_ns = PERCENTILE(event.duration, 99) BY time = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL p50_ms = ROUND(p50_ns / 1000000, 1), p95_ms = ROUND(p95_ns / 1000000, 1), p99_ms = ROUND(p99_ns / 1000000, 1)
| KEEP time, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms
| SORT time

FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND url.path != "/health"
| STATS p95_ns = PERCENTILE(event.duration, 95), requests = COUNT(*) BY route = url.path
| EVAL p95_ms = ROUND(p95_ns / 1000000, 1)
| SORT p95_ms DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-apache.error-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__" AND (apache.error.module == "proxy" OR apache.error.module == "proxy_http" OR MATCH(message, "proxy"))
| STATS proxy_errors = COUNT(*)

FROM metrics-apache.status-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 1
| EVAL workers_total = apache.status.workers.busy + apache.status.workers.idle
| EVAL saturation_pct = CASE(workers_total > 0, ROUND(apache.status.workers.busy * 100.0 / workers_total, 1), 0.0)
| KEEP saturation_pct

FROM metrics-apache.status-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__"
| STATS busy = MAX(apache.status.workers.busy), idle = MAX(apache.status.workers.idle) BY time = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time

config.content:
## Sécurité

Authentifications, limitations de débit, enrôlements, révocations et autres événements d'audit OpenIRN.

data_source.query:
FROM logs-openirn.security-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS events = COUNT(*) BY time = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), action = event.action
| SORT time

FROM logs-openirn.security-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND openirn.security.reason IS NOT NULL
| STATS events = COUNT(*) BY reason = openirn.security.reason
| SORT events DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-openirn.security-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND (event.action LIKE "auth.*" OR event.action LIKE "authorization.*")
| STATS authentication_events = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openirn.security-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND event.action LIKE "*.rate_limited"
| STATS rate_limited_events = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openirn.security-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND (event.action LIKE "enrollment.*" OR event.action LIKE "enrollment_request.*")
| STATS enrollment_events = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openirn.security-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND (event.action LIKE "*.revoked" OR event.action LIKE "*.deleted")
| STATS revocation_events = COUNT(*)

config.content:
## Infrastructure

CPU, mémoire, swap, disque, MariaDB et état des services systemd.

data_source.query:
FROM metrics-system.cpu-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 1
| EVAL cpu_pct = ROUND(system.cpu.total.norm.pct * 100, 1)
| KEEP cpu_pct

FROM metrics-system.memory-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 1
| EVAL memory_pct = ROUND(system.memory.actual.used.pct * 100, 1)
| KEEP memory_pct

FROM metrics-system.memory-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 1
| EVAL swap_pct = ROUND(system.memory.swap.used.pct * 100, 1)
| KEEP swap_pct

FROM metrics-system.filesystem-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__" AND system.filesystem.mount_point == "/"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 1
| EVAL disk_pct = ROUND(system.filesystem.used.pct * 100, 1)
| KEEP disk_pct

FROM metrics-mysql.status-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP mysql.status.threads.connected

FROM metrics-mysql.status-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP mysql.status.threads.running

FROM metrics-mysql.status-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP mysql.status.aborted.connects

config.title: Infrastructure — état des services systemd (1 = actif)

data_source.query:
FROM metrics-linux.service-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__" AND system.service.name IN ("openirn-api.service", "openirn-api-backup.timer", "apache2.service", "mariadb.service")
| STATS state = LATEST(system.service.state) BY service = system.service.name
| EVAL is_active = CASE(state == "active", 1, 0)
| SORT service

config.title: Infrastructure — services systemd dans le temps

data_source.query:
FROM metrics-linux.service-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__" AND system.service.name IN ("openirn-api.service", "openirn-api-backup.timer", "apache2.service", "mariadb.service")
| STATS samples = COUNT(*) BY time = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), state = system.service.state
| SORT time

FROM metrics-mysql.status-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__"
| STATS connected = MAX(mysql.status.threads.connected), running = MAX(mysql.status.threads.running) BY time = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time

config.content:
## Exploitation

Sauvegardes, redémarrages, certificat TLS et version de l'API déployée.

data_source.query:
FROM logs-openirn.operations-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND event.action == "service.started"
| STATS api_starts = COUNT(*)

FROM synthetics-http-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND service.name == "openirn-api" AND tls.server.x509.not_after IS NOT NULL
| STATS certificate_expiry = MAX(tls.server.x509.not_after)
| EVAL tls_days_remaining = DATE_DIFF("day", NOW(), certificate_expiry)
| KEEP tls_days_remaining

FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND service.version IS NOT NULL
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY version = service.version
| SORT requests DESC

FROM logs-openirn.operations-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND event.action LIKE "backup.*"
| STATS backups = COUNT(*) BY time = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), outcome = event.outcome
| SORT time
